verdict.rationale: Google DeepMind publishes an HTML and PDF model card for the current flagship, Gemini 4 Argon (October 2026). It covers model information, training data, evaluation, intended usage and limitations, and safety, with published safety evaluation tables and a known-limitations section. The model page separately documents capability specs such as the context window. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the card's contents, and quoted detail of capability benchmark results beyond the section listing.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can read a published model card or system card — capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use — for the current flagship model

citations.quote: Sections: Model Information, Model Data (training dataset), Implementation and Sustainability, Distribution, Evaluation, Intended Usage and Limitations, Safety & Security.
Gemini 4 Argon may exhibit some of the general limitations of foundation models, such as hallucinations.
Internal safety evaluation results tables are published on the same page.
